title: Tom Emmer announces endorsements for three Florida congressional candidates
text:
Tom Emmer announces endorsements for three Florida congressional candidates
L. R. Segura
Tom Emmer, U.S. Congressman representing Minnesota’s 6th district since 2015, announced a series of endorsements for congressional candidates in Florida through his official Twitter account on September 2, 2026.
In the first post at 18:06 UTC, Emmer stated: "Proud to announce my endorsement of an America First Patriot and the next Congressman for #FL19, @JimSchwartzel! Jim will fight hard for our conservative values in Congress."
Shortly after, at 18:08 UTC, he posted another endorsement: "Proud to announce my endorsement of a MAGA warrior, veteran, husband, and father, @CaseyAskar! Casey will be an America First Patriot in Congress and a great representative for the good people of #FL22."
At 18:09 UTC on the same day, Emmer added: "Proud to announce my endorsement of an America First Patriot and conservative leader, @ScottSingerUSA! #FL25, Scott won’t let you down as your next Congressman."
Emmer has represented Minnesota's 6th District since succeeding Michele Bachmann in 2015. Before his tenure in Congress, he served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 to 2011. Born in South Bend, Indiana in 1961 and currently residing in Delano at age 62, Emmer holds a BA from the University of Alaska-Fairbanks (1984) and a JD from William Mitchell College of Law (1988).
